levelCards.n1: Highest proficiency level. Read editorial articles, analyze specialized texts, and grasp complex discussions.
levelCards.n2: Upper-intermediate level. Required for studying and working in Japanese companies.
levelCards.n3: Bridge to intermediate level. Understand everyday situations spoken at natural speed.
levelCards.n4: Elementary 2. Grasp basic everyday conversations and comprehend short passages.
levelCards.n5: Elementary 1. Master Hiragana, Katakana, basic Kanji, and everyday simple phrases.
